_comment: Sample seminar plans, rendered by scripts/make-flowchart.py into flowchart.org.  Chapters are named by sheet ID (the Denote timestamp): [[ID]] renders as 'Chapter N, Title' with a link, [ID] as the number N with a link, <ID ID ...> as 'Chapters 3, 5 and 8' with links (in index order, runs of three or more compressed to 'N–M'), {ID} as the bare number N (for section and theorem numbers such as §{ID}.2).

sessions: [[20261125T010000]], with the main theorem of [[20261125T010500]] stated

[[20261126T030300]], with the statements of Theorems A and B (<20261126T030600 20261126T020210>)

plans.title: Full version, 25 sessions
after: <20261126T030400 20261126T030500 20261126T030700 20261126T030800 20261126T030900 20261126T031000>, which prove Theorems A and C, are reading for the presenters of the last sessions or a second semester.
A second semester, or student talks, could take the side series [[20261124T220500]] and [[20261124T221500]], a model in the function-field setting that the proof does not use.

notes: Run Part III with two presenters per sheet for Chapters [20261124T214500] and [20261125T013700].
